story: Intimate morning mirror check in Seongsu flat wearing delicate black lace lingerie set.
prompt: An intimate candid mirror selfie of a stunning 26-year-old Korean woman in her Seongsu flat bedroom. She is wearing a delicate black sheer lace bralette and matching lace briefs, bare toned athletic midriff, sculpted waist and clavicles, subtle botanical sprig tattoo on her side ribs. Soft natural morning sunlight streaming from a window across unmade white linen sheets. Her honey-balayage hair falls in loose slept-in waves. The phone visible in her hand in the mirror reflection is her own: a white iPhone 15 Pro with white back glass, natural titanium edges, and a plain clear transparent case. She holds it at waist height, adjusting one shoulder strap with a calm intimate gaze. Shot on iPhone 15 Pro through the glass: flat HDR contrast, low saturation, fine noise in shadows, natural matte skin with visible pores.
caption: quiet mornings in seongsu before the day starts... something a little more private for you 🖤☕
